entries.german:
Miscellanea Brandenburgica

Enthält-/Darin-Vermerke: Enthält: 1.) Gelehrte Bedenken in der Streitsache zwischen Markgraf Georg Friedrich von Brandenburg und der Ritterschaft im Fürstentum Jägerndorf (Manuskript).  - 2.) Schraderi Responsum eben deswegen, o.D. (Mskr.). - 3.) Responsum facultatis iuridicae academiae Ingolstadiensis super mineris plumbi prope oppidum Beuten in ducatu Oppoliensi erichtentibus nebst Gutachten der Universitäten zu Heidelberg und Leipzig, 1563 (Manuskript). - 4. Friedrich Fischers Ratschlag, die Belehnung des Markgrafen Georg von Brandenburg mit den schlesischen Herrschaften Oppeln und Ratibor, 1527 (Manuskript).
5.) Consilia aliquot in variis iuris casibus, o.D. (Manuskript). - 6.) Levini de Bulau consilium in causa contra senatum et communitatem oppidi Regiomontani super turbata iurisdictione, o.D. (Manuskript, Autograph). - 7.) Etliche Stücke, die Herrschaft Bitberg betreffend (Manuskript, orig.). - 8.) Streitigkeiten wegen der schlesischen Herrschaften Beuthen und Oderberg, o.D. (Manuskript). - 9.) Gutachten des Dr. Kiliani Synappii in Betreff des vom Kardinal von Lothringen dem Kammerjunker Johann von Savigny auf Lebenszeit überlassenen Schlosses Albersdorf, o.D. (Manuskript). - 10.) Responsum iuris in causa feudali der Landgrafen von Hessen gegen das adelige Geschlecht der Wolfen von Gudenberg, die halbe Herrschaft Itter betreffend, 1558 (Manuskript).  - 11.) Kgl. Preußisches Patent, die Aufnahme der Salzburgischen Emigranten in den Preußischen Landen betreffend, 1732 (Druck). - 12.) Rechtliches Bedenken über die Bestrafung der Wildpretschützen, o.D. (Manuskript). - 13.) Rechtliches Bedenken über die von den Schödern zu Windsheim geschehene Übergabe des Patronatsrechtes auf St. Katharinen-Altar in der Pfarrkirche allda resp. der darauf gestifteten Vikarien, o.D. (Manuskript). - 14.) Consilium de validitate potestatis a sede apostolica praeposito Eystetensi executori datae ad providendum Georgio Wettelsheimer de ecclesia parochiali in Wettelsheim, o.D. (Manuskript). - 15.) Consilium iurisconsulti cuiusdam, causam Sebaldi et Ludovici Pfinzing concernens, o.D. (Manuskript). - 16.) Consilium in causa Alb. Wagneri contra Balth. Pöhmer, o.D. (Manuskript). -  17.) Consilium iurisconsulti cuiusdam, castrum Jtter concernens, o. D. (Manuskript). -18.) Species facti in Sachen v. Luchau et Hunsberg punkto haereditatis, o.D. (Druck). - 19.) Repraesentatio status causae in Sachen des Freiherrn von Stein gegen die brandenburg-kulmbach'sche Regierung, o.D. (Druck). - 20.) Species facti in Sachen des Freiherrn v. Stein gegen dessen Töchter puncto haereditatis pp, o.D. (Druck). - 20a.) Consilium, v. Rosenberg'sche Erbschaftssachen betr., 1608 (Manuskript). - 21.) Consilium, Erbschaftsstreitigkeiten betreffend, o.D. (Mskr.).
22.) Responsum der Juristen-Fakultät zu Jena, das Testament der Eva Derslin betr., 1729 (Manuskript). - 23.) Consilium Dr. Kiliani de Jtzstein, Testamentum Agnetis Pacherin Norinbergensis concernens, o.D. (Manuskript). - 24.) Consilium Dr. Georgii Fradelii de usuris quincuntia libus et utrum hint licitae, o.D. (Manuskript). - 25.) Rechtliche Bedenken über die Einziehung der dem geächteten Wilhelm von Grumbach zugehörigen, vom Stift Würzburg zu Lehen gehenden Güter, o.D. (Manuskript). - 26.) Zu Nürnberg aufgerichteter Münzabschied der Kreise Franken, Schwaben und Bayern, 1725 (Druck). - 27.) Münzverordnung des Fränkischen Kreises, 1732 (Druck). - 28.) Programmata Joh. Georgii Buehta, quibus synodi indicuntur, 1728, 1730, 1732 (Druck). - 29.) Fropaeum Fridericianum sive memorabilia Borussica, 1708 (Druck).  - 30.) Ein Kaufbrief über ein Haus zu Neustädtlein am Forst, 1626 (Manuskript). - 31.) Kaufbriefe über zwei Häuser zu Bayreuth, 1623 und 1626 (Manuskript). - 32.) Eine von einem Einwohner zu Wunsiedel errichtete letztwillige Verfügung, o.D. (Manuskript). - 33.) Statuten des Brandenburg-Kulmbachischen Ordens de la Sincérité [Ordens der Aufrichtigkeit, gegründet durch Erbprinz Georg Wilhelm von Brandenburg-Bayreuth, später als Roter-Adler-Orden bezeichnet], 1705 (Druck). - 34.) Statuten des Brandenburgischen Roten Adler Ordens, 1734 (Druck). - 35.) Verhandlungen bei einem im Jahr 1526 zu Onolzbach gehaltenen Landtag, Religions-Streitigkeiten und Türkenhilfe betreffend (Manuskript).
entries.english: Miscellanea Brandenburgica. Contents: (1) Scholarly opinions in the dispute between Margrave Georg Friedrich of Brandenburg and the knighthood in the Principality of Jägerndorf (manuscript). (2) Schrader's opinion on the same matter, undated (manuscript). (3) Opinion of the Faculty of Law of the University of Ingolstadt concerning lead mines established near the town of Beuten in the Duchy of Oppeln, together with opinions of the universities of Heidelberg and Leipzig, 1563 (manuscript). (4) Friedrich Fischer's advice concerning the enfeoffment of Margrave Georg of Brandenburg with the Silesian lordships of Oppeln and Ratibor, 1527 (manuscript). (5) Several legal opinions in various cases, undated (manuscript). (6) Legal opinion by Levin de Bulau in the case against the council and community of the town of Königsberg concerning disturbed jurisdiction, undated (autograph manuscript). (7) Several items concerning the lordship of Bitberg (original manuscripts). (8) Disputes concerning the Silesian lordships of Beuthen and Oderberg, undated (manuscript). (9) Opinion by Dr. Kilian Synappius concerning Albersdorf Castle, which the Cardinal of Lorraine granted to the chamberlain Johann von Savigny for life, undated (manuscript). (10) Legal opinion in the feudal case of the Landgraves of Hesse against the noble Wolfen von Gudenberg family concerning half the lordship of Itter, 1558 (manuscript). (11) Royal Prussian patent concerning the reception of Salzburg emigrants in Prussian lands, 1732 (printed). (12) Legal opinion concerning the punishment of poachers, undated (manuscript). (13) Legal opinion concerning the transfer by the Schöder family of the right of patronage to St Catherine's altar in the parish church there at Windsheim, or the benefices founded on it, undated (manuscript). (14) Legal opinion on the validity of the power granted by the Apostolic See to the provost of Eichstätt as executor to provide Georg Wettelsheimer with the parish church at Wettelsheim, undated (manuscript). (15) Legal opinion concerning Sebald and Ludovicus Pfinzing, undated (manuscript). (16) Legal opinion in the case of Alb. Wagner against Balth. Pöhmer, undated (manuscript). (17) Legal opinion concerning Itter Castle, undated (manuscript). (18) Statement of facts in the matter of Luchau and Hunsberg on inheritance, undated (printed). (19) Presentation of the status of the case of Baron von Stein against the government of Brandenburg-Kulmbach, undated (printed). (20) Statement of facts in the inheritance matter of Baron von Stein against his daughters, undated (printed). (20a) Legal opinion concerning von Rosenberg inheritance cases, 1608 (manuscript). (21) Legal opinion concerning inheritance disputes, undated (manuscript). (22) Opinion of the Faculty of Law at Jena concerning Eva Derslin's will, 1729 (manuscript). (23) Legal opinion by Dr. Kilian de Itzstein concerning the will of Agnes Pacherin of Nuremberg, undated (manuscript). (24) Legal opinion by Dr. Georg Fradelius concerning interest at five per cent and whether it is lawful, undated (manuscript). (25) Legal opinion concerning confiscation of the goods belonging to the proscribed Wilhelm von Grumbach, held as fiefs from Würzburg, undated (manuscript). (26) Coinage agreement concluded at Nuremberg by the Franconian, Swabian, and Bavarian Circles, 1725 (printed). (27) Coinage ordinance of the Franconian Circle, 1732 (printed). (28) Programmes of Johann Georg Buehta announcing synods, 1728, 1730, 1732 (printed). (29) Fropaeum Fridericianum sive memorabilia Borussica, 1708 (printed). (30) Deed of sale for a house at Neustädtlein am Forst, 1626 (manuscript). (31) Deeds of sale for two houses at Bayreuth, 1623 and 1626 (manuscripts). (32) Testamentary disposition made by a resident of Wunsiedel, undated (manuscript). (33) Statutes of the Brandenburg-Kulmbach Order of Sincerity [founded by Hereditary Prince Georg Wilhelm of Brandenburg-Bayreuth, later known as the Order of the Red Eagle], 1705 (printed). (34) Statutes of the Brandenburg Red Eagle Order, 1734 (printed). (35) Proceedings of a diet held at Onolzbach in 1526 concerning religious disputes and aid against the Turks (manuscript).
